Jaishankar meets Canadian counterpart Anand at G20

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting. They discussed Prime Minister Modi's planned visit to Canada in December. The meeting took place during the G20 Foreign Ministers' meet.
